description: teas.co.uk, a UK online tea shop, as a small website inside the chat. Pick a page: "home" (what is there, offers, news), "shop" (search and browse tea and hot chocolate with live prices: words in query, or category, brand, kind, caffeine, on_offer, max_price (pounds a pack), max_price_per_cup (pence), with_milk, strength, format, organic, fairtrade, vegan, sort and page_number), "tea" (one tea in full by id or name: pictures, taste, brewing timer, wiki, recipes, similar and cheaper teas), "compare" (two to four ids side by side), "wiki" (search the Tea Wiki with query, or open an article by id), "recipes" (search with query, or open one by id), "news" (list, or open a story by id), "under_the_hood" (live findings on how AI systems use the shop), "socials", "delivery" (delivery and returns; with items and country it prices a basket), "join" (what a teas.co.uk account adds) or "report" (send a product or site problem to the team: issue_type and details). Everything here only reads, except report. For advice in plain English use ask_lee; to buy use basket.

brand.description: Shop: brand name; the brand is described at the top.

country.description: Delivery: two letter country code, for example GB, IE or FR.

details.description: Report: what looks wrong, in a sentence or two. No personal details.

format.description: Shop: tea bags or loose leaf.

id.description: For tea: a product id, link, barcode or name. For wiki, recipes or news: the item id or link.

ids.description: For compare: two to four product ids.

max_price.description: Shop: highest pack price in pounds, for example 5 or 4.99.

max_price_per_cup.description: Shop: highest price per cup in pence, for example 5.

on_offer.description: Shop: only products on offer now.

page_number.description: Shop, recipes or news: page number from 1.

query.description: Words to search for (shop, wiki, recipes).

suggested_correction.description: Report: what you believe is right, and where that comes from.

with_milk.description: Shop: true for teas that suit milk, false for teas best without.

name: teas

outputSchema.description: The page or result; its shape depends on page, section or action.
